source.title: Recent developments and some open problems in Finsler geometry

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 2065795. Local shard metadata identified the exact work as 'Recent developments and some open problems in Finsler geometry' with DOI 10.1007/BF02900677.

failure_mode=blocked_or_challenged. The direct zbMATH record URL did not expose a readable record body through the available page reader. The zbMATH REST API root exposed only its terms prompt, the local shell environment could not resolve or connect to api.zbmath.org, and exact-ID searches did not recover a readable record body.

failure_mode=metadata_only. The DOI landing page at Springer confirmed the title, authors, journal, pages, and DOI, but it was a subscription preview/metadata page and not usable as the technical source for open-problem extraction.

failure_mode=missing_or_invalid_artifact. Exact-title and exact-phrase searches surfaced candidate SciEngine PDF URLs for the same title, including https://cdn.sciengine.com/doi/pdf/18bb72b35faa46eb88ad6f3218934b4f and https://www.sciengine.com/doi/pdfView/18bb72b35faa46eb88ad6f3218934b4f, but the available page reader could not open them as a readable PDF artifact and the local environment had network sockets disabled. Search-result snippets were therefore rejected under the source-adequacy gate and were not used for extraction.
No doc_map was created because no readable primary PDF or full HTML artifact for the exact work was available.
Candidate extraction was skipped under the no-snippets and source-adequacy gates.
No items were accepted because every accepted item requires full-text evidence with page numbers or stable locators from a readable primary source.
Saved the exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-2065795.json and outputs/latest.json.
